{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Karadan''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. With a metropolitan-area population of roughly 1.4 million, it is one of the larger settlements in the country outside the capital region around [[Faramozan]].

The city is home to the Karadan National Park Stadium, a 65,400-seat venue used as one of the principal stadiums of the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]], where it staged the second semi-final between [[Easuhura]] and [[Verusa]] on 9 July 1760. A high-speed rail link between Karadan and [[Veshgadar]], completed in February 1760, was built in part to support the city's tournament hosting role.
